## History

Alonzo was the late father of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Years after his death, a bundle of love letters written between him and Anne's mother was given to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by the current occupant of their old home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Reading these letters allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to feel truly connected to Alonzo and her mother for the first time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alonzo--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) is a social acquaintance and hometown friend of Alonzo's, who is also pursuing a romantic courtship with them. During a pleasant fortnight together in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she explores her birthplace, visits her parents' former home, and receives a bundle of their old love letters from the current occupant. After visiting her parents' graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads these letters at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly), deepening her personal connection to her family history while sharing the experience alongside [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P1](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0001), [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), +5 more_
